description: This file defines an abstract repository interface for notes, outlining methods for CRUD operations on note entities.

classes.name: NotesRepository
classes.description: An abstract class providing the contract for persisting notes, including methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting notes.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all notes, optionally filtered by a query string.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its ID, returning null if not found.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new note and returns the created entity.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing note and returns the updated entity.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID.
